What the shop does

Watches

A large watch selection. One review calls it one of the best in Cyprus, for all budgets.

Jewellery

Earrings, necklaces, bracelets and rings. Among the Google review keywords, jewellery selection appears seven times.

Engagement and wedding rings

Rings for the proposal and for the wedding, also made to order. Customers write that their custom ring came out perfect.

Repairs

New clasps, batteries and the renovation of old jewellery. One review describes a broken necklace lock replaced within five minutes.

A family business on Georgiou A’

Zacharias Watches & Jewellery is in the Pecora Beach House on Georgiou A’ in Limassol, open six days a week, with 2.900 followers on Facebook. In its replies to reviews the shop calls itself a family business. Its own photos show earrings on red velvet, wedding bands and rings in rose gold. There is no website of its own: the Google listing has no website entry.
